\section[le feu rouge]{le feu rouge — a red light}

\label{lesson:FR-C108-feu-rouge}

Before the new one: say the French for a pavement, then the French for a crossroads.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: le feu rouge}
\textbf{le feu rouge} — \textquotedblleft{}a red light\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{le feu} is a fire; at a crossing it is the traffic light.
